thread:
Maria (CS): Hey team, PioneerHealth is going live in APAC tomorrow morning and wants EU traffic routed to eu-west for GDPR reasons. They also asked for a temporary +3x rate-limit bump for the first 48h during demo traffic. Can we do a region split and add their IP ranges to the edge allowlist? Also flagging this as a renewal risk — they want low friction on day1.

Dan (Infra): On it. Can you drop the CIDRs and which models/routes need the bump? We can do a routing rule to prefer eu-west1 for EU-origin requests and fall back to hosted for everything else.

Maria (CS): CIDRs from the customer: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25. Routes: /v1/chat for prod and /v1/embed for search. Rate bump: baseline 200 qps -> 600 qps for 48h starting 2026-04-15T08:00Z.

Raj (Networking): Got the CIDRs. Quick note: if we add to edge allowlist we need to update both apac edge and eu edge peering ACLs. I can push the change but would like a deploy window. Any specific SLA for the update?

Olivia (SE): PioneerHealth is on a renewal discussion — if we hit any friction they'll escalate. Prefer ASAP. If we can stage the changes pre-demo that would be ideal. I'll be on the enablement call at 07:45 UTC to verify.

Kevin (Support): I can monitor errors and alerts during the window. Please add me to the notification channel for any 5xx/latency spikes.

Dan (Infra): Plan: 1) Pre-stage allowlist on staging edges and run connectivity smoke. 2) At T-30m apply to eu/apac edges (rolling) 3) Apply rate limit override at control-plane for the two routes. 4) Canary: route 5% of EU CIDR traffic to eu-west1 for 15m then ramp.

Maria (CS): Sounds good. Can you paste the API call we’ll use to set the rate override so I can include in the runbook?

Dan (Infra): curl -X POST https://control.redwood.ai/v1/customers/pioneerhealth/config 
-H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
-H "Content-Type: application/json" 
-d '{
  "overrides": [
    {"route": "/v1/chat", "qps": 600, "window": "48h"},
    {"route": "/v1/embed", "qps": 600, "window": "48h"}
  ],
  "traffic_rules": [{"match": "geo = EU and src_ip in [\"203.0.113.0/24\", \"198.51.100.128/25\"]", "prefer_region": "eu-west1", "weight": 95}]
}'

Raj (Networking): I'll push ACLs. After I stage, I'll paste the edge-change commit hash here and tag @Dan and @Kevin for rollout.

deploy-bot: Scheduled change created #chg-20260415-3789, window 2026-04-15T07:30Z -> 2026-04-15T09:30Z. Please ack.

Kevin (Support): Acked. I'll set a PagerDuty escalation to on-call if error rate > 1% or latency > 500ms p50 for the routes.

Olivia (SE): I'll join the 07:45UTC enablement call and collect immediate feedback from the demo team. Also sending a renewal note to the CSM to discuss post-demo.

Maria (CS): Thanks all — last ask: can we auto-revoke the +3x after 48h? We don't want permanent leakage.

Dan (Infra): Yes — the override has an expiry. We'll verify the revoke job runs and put a follow-up check into the runbook: 
- verify revoke at +50h via control API: GET /v1/customers/pioneerhealth/config -> ensure overrides empty

Maria (CS): Perfect. I'll update the enablement agenda and paste these steps. Please post the edge commit and control API request IDs when done. :thumbsup:

Raj (Networking): edge commit: abc1234-update-acl, pushed to staging. Will promote to prod at T-30m.

Dan (Infra): Control API change id: cfg-change-5907. Applying canary now to staging.

Kevin (Support): Monitoring hooks added to channel. I'll post any anomalies there.

Maria (CS): Great teamwork — let's aim for a smooth demo and close renewal. :rocket:
